alerts.title: Boil water notice
alerts.teaser: Boil tap water before drinking until further notice.
alerts.body:
Boil tap water before drinking until further notice.

A main break on the east campus has dropped pressure below the safe threshold. Bottled water is available at every information desk.

alerts.title: Lot B closed Saturday
alerts.markdown: Lot B is closed Saturday for resurfacing. Use **Lot C** or the deck.
